name: FF-one-floor
old: const sent = this._foesSend(ws, a, kind, data, length, ranged, bucket, now, first ? -FOES_FULL_RESERVE : FOES_FULL_RESERVE, lane);
new: const sent = this._foesSend(ws, a, kind, data, length, ranged, bucket, now, FOES_FULL_RESERVE, lane);
note: every frame stopped at the reserve - no frame first

name: FF-first-floor-empty
old: const sent = this._foesSend(ws, a, kind, data, length, ranged, bucket, now, first ? -FOES_FULL_RESERVE : FOES_FULL_RESERVE, lane);
new: const sent = this._foesSend(ws, a, kind, data, length, ranged, bucket, now, first ? 0 : FOES_FULL_RESERVE, lane);
note: a first frame may spend the reserve but borrow nothing - a full fan past the reserve never goes into a room the deltas hold

name: FF-delta-no-reserve
old:
const sent = this._foesSend(ws, a, kind, data, length, ranged, bucket, now, FOES_FULL_RESERVE, lane);
      return sent.pass ? sent.bucket : this._foesDropped(full, sent.bucket);
new:
const sent = this._foesSend(ws, a, kind, data, length, ranged, bucket, now, 0, lane);
      return sent.pass ? sent.bucket : this._foesDropped(full, sent.bucket);
note: the deltas spend the reserve too - the old law's starvation

name: FF-full-borrows-whole
old: const budget = floorGate(bucket, now, per * listeners.length, FOES_ROOM_BYTES_PER_S, floor);
new: const budget = first ? byteGate(bucket, now, per * listeners.length, FOES_ROOM_BYTES_PER_S, true) : floorGate(bucket, now, per * listeners.length, FOES_ROOM_BYTES_PER_S, floor);
note: a first frame borrows its whole fan's cost (byteGate's borrow) - the debt unbounded by the reserve

name: FF-ahead-floor-empty
old: const ahead = floorGate(bucket, now, per, FOES_ROOM_BYTES_PER_S, floor);
new: const ahead = floorGate(bucket, now, per, FOES_ROOM_BYTES_PER_S, 0);
note: the ask ahead of the walk at byteGate's floor - a delta below its reserve walks the room, a first frame in debt is refused one it could afford
